attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Pharmacy (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE- or CCCEP-accredited providers; AMA Category I programs; Board-approved programs (incl. in-state approved providers and Canadian provincial authorities); comparable CE approved by other state boards of pharmacy
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first biennial renewal.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the renewal application under penalty of unsworn falsification; keep certificates 3 years. At least 10% of registrants randomly audited after Oct 1 of every even year.
rules.notes: Renewal application due Dec 15 of each even year (license renewal date Jan 1); 30 hours in the 24 months before Jan 1, at least 10 hours live (ACPE webinars with 'L' count as live). Fee $270 for authorized immunizing pharmacists. Applies to active and inactive licensees.
